provenance: GitHub archival JPEG branch; JPEG bytes verified against historical SHA256 during this run

method.color: OpenCV HSV hand-set thresholds of JPEG pixels incl. blue, green, red, yellow/ochre and dark, without parchment/color calibration
method.regions: OpenCV connected-component contours and Canny edges, normalized bounding boxes with dHash64 descriptors
method.similarity: cross-canvas perceptual dHash <=7 with aspect and area filters; similarity is NOT object identity
method.confidence: No model accuracy established; every machine ROI and match requires independent human assessment
